title: 第七章 流言风波
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
被葛长老的威亚震伤后，苍岚捂着胸口，避开人群遁回自己的住处，狼狈地靠着门滑坐在地，抬手抹去嘴角的血痕。

    原来她食言，不是因为腻了。

    她是真的被看管起来了……

    所以外边那些离谱的流言，居然都是真的？

    堂堂神机门大小姐，会为了他这只半妖顶撞门主？会散尽家财只为博他一笑？会把传家信物和命门交给他？

    会……对他这种卑贱半妖动了真感情？

    这怎么可能呢……

    苍岚平复下翻涌的气血，忍着妖丹处传来的撕心裂肺的疼痛，一点一点挪到床边，从床下取出一个不起眼的箱子。

    他摩挲着箱子边沿，慢慢打开。

    曾经被他扫落在地的法器，滚落到角落里的药膏，如今都被整整齐齐地珍藏在箱子里。

    苍岚一言不发地看着华丽的法器，心里翻涌的酸涩将刚刚露头的暖意掩埋。

    不过是风流小姐从指缝里漏出来的丁点注意罢了……她见色起意，他另有所图，仅此而已。

    苍岚脸色阴郁下来，咣当一声砸上箱盖，将箱子踹进床底。

    葛长老的言外之意，他听得分明。

    他，他们，都对半妖嗤之以鼻！都把半妖当成异类孽畜！

    什么真心，什么偏爱。虚无缥缈的感情，只会拖累他的脚步！

    苍岚沉沉呼出一口气，外放的情绪重新被按回躯壳，他又变回了隐忍沉默的外门半妖。

    他最后看了床底一眼，挽好袖子，准备去采运冶炼所需的石矿，屋门却被敲响了。

    苍岚平静地打开门，闭眼迎接习以为常的乱拳。

    意料之内的疼痛并未传来，苍岚微微皱眉，睁开眼。

    到访之人，是一位外门师姐。

    有些眼熟。

    “小师妹动了些关系，你这几天不必去服劳役。”

    一提“小师妹”，苍岚就记起来了。

    这就是当初陪萧姚演戏的那位师姐吧。

    “小师妹这几日家中有事，托我关照你。这是她留给你的灵石，收下吧。”

    “小师妹与宗门执法队相熟，有她在，必不会再有人寻你麻……烦……唉不是？你怎么受伤了！！！”

    祁妙心里还惦记着收集信息的事，本想安抚完苍岚就撤，结果递储物袋时，发现他手上居然有血迹！

    到底是哪个挨千刀的给她添乱！这让她怎么给大小姐交差！！

    “祖宗，你这是内伤还是外伤？什么时候在哪里谁干的？我我给你找药！”

    祁妙觉得她的腿又开始发软了，帮萧姚找后宫的心情都没了。

    大小姐总共就交代了两句话，七个人的选妃占了一句，这个半妖自己独占一句。

    她就是再傻也能品出味儿，这半妖才是真正被大小姐惦记着的正宫啊！！！

    “这个你先服下，地品的丹药我身上没有，我这就找人去借。”

    “你好好修养！求求你一定要快点养好伤！！！”

    祁妙撒腿就往内门跑，生怕萧姚下一秒就传讯问情况，自己背锅脱一层皮。

    苍岚注视着祁妙着急忙慌的背影，眼睛里难得出现了一丝茫然。

    他低头看着手里的储物袋，回想着祁妙的话语，脑子逐渐转不动了。

    她受制于人不能亲自来寻他，所以托人来关照他？

    师姐那般紧张他的安危，也是因为她的叮嘱？
content_en:
After being injured by Elder Ge's Wia, Cang Lan covered her chest, avoided the crowd and fled back to her residence. She sat on the ground awkwardly leaning against the door and raised her hand to wipe away the blood on the corner of her mouth.

It turns out that she broke her promise not because she was tired of it.

She is really under guard...

So those outrageous rumors outside are actually true?

Would the dignified eldest lady of the Divine Machine Sect contradict the sect master for his half-demon?Will you spend all your wealth just to make him laugh?Will you give him the family heirloom and life gate?

Would... have true feelings for a lowly half-demon like him?

How is this possible...

Cang Lan calmed down the surging energy and blood, endured the heartbreaking pain coming from the demon pill, and moved to the bed little by little, and took out an inconspicuous box from under the bed.

He rubbed the edge of the box and slowly opened it.

The magical instruments that he once swept to the ground and the ointments that rolled into the corner are now neatly stored in the box.

Cang Lan looked at the gorgeous magic weapon without saying a word, the sourness in her heart burying the warmth that had just emerged.

It was just a little bit of attention leaked from the fingers of the romantic lady... She got interested, and he had other plans, that's all.

Cang Lan's face turned gloomy, she slammed the lid of the box with a bang and kicked the box under the bed.

He could clearly hear what Elder Ge meant.

He and they all sneered at the half-demon!They all regard half-demon as a different beast!

What is sincerity and what is preference.Vain emotions will only slow him down!

Cang Lan let out a deep breath, and his outward emotions were pushed back into his body, and he turned back into the silent outer half-demon.

He took one last look under the bed, rolled up his sleeves, and was about to mine and transport the quarry needed for smelting, when there was a knock on the door.

Cang Lan opened the door calmly and closed her eyes to receive the usual fists.

The unexpected pain did not come, Cang Lan frowned slightly and opened her eyes.

The person visiting was a senior sister from the outer sect.

Something looks familiar.

"Junior sister has made some connections. You don't have to do hard labor these days."

As soon as she mentioned "little junior sister", Cang Lan remembered it.

This must be the senior sister who accompanied Xiao Yao when she acted.

"Junior sister has something to do at home these days, so I asked me to take care of you. This is the spiritual stone she left for you, please accept it."

"Junior sister is familiar with the sect's law enforcement team. With her here, no one will look for trouble...trouble with you...oh, isn't it? Why are you injured!!!"

Qi Miao was still thinking about collecting information. She wanted to leave after comforting Cang Lan, but when she handed over the storage bag, she found blood on his hands!

Who was the one who had been stabbed a thousand times to cause trouble for her?How can this make her work for the eldest lady!!

"Ancestor, are you suffering from internal injuries or external injuries? When, where and who did it? I will find you some medicine!"

Qi Miao felt that her legs were starting to feel weak again, and she was no longer in the mood to help Xiao Yao find a harem.

The eldest lady only gave two sentences in total, one sentence for the seven concubines, and one sentence for the half-demon.

No matter how stupid she is, she can still taste it. This half-demon is the real palace that the eldest lady cares about!!!

"Take this first. I don't have any of the local elixirs. I'll find someone to borrow them right now."

"Take good care of yourself! Please heal your injuries quickly!!!"

Qi Miao ran towards the inner door, fearing that Xiao Yao would call in to ask about the situation in the next second, and she would take the blame.

Cang Lan stared at Qi Miao's hurried back, with a rare trace of confusion in her eyes.

He looked down at the storage bag in his hand, thinking about Qi Miao's words, and his mind gradually stopped moving.

She was restricted by others and couldn't find him in person, so she asked someone to take care of him?

Is it because of her instructions that Senior Sister is so worried about his safety?
